identification: Two long narrow rough-sawn live-edge boards, pale yellow with dark pin flecks, catalogued as Huon pine. Photo shows plain, knotty, checked boards with no figure (not birds-eye or fiddleback), roughly 1.5 to 2.3 m long, perhaps 15 to 25 cm wide. Ordinary grade, same stock and sale as the many 'SLAB OF HUON PINE' lots in this and recent Gowans sales.

viewing_check: Measure width, length and thickness of both boards. Check they are really Huon pine (yellow, fine pin knots, resinous smell) and look for any figure such as birds-eye or fiddleback, and for splits or rot. Mostly decided by the photo: plain knotty narrow boards, expect about $50 to $105 hammer.
